basic_info.description: Two beautifully maintained vacant full floor flats with high ceilings and period details. Top unit has 3 bedrooms and 1 bath with a spacious unwarranted skylit ventilated attic space that has been used as a 4th sleeping area and a play room. Lower unit has 2 bedrooms and 1 bath. 4-car garage with a separate side entrance which offers a large blank canvas with expansion potential within the building footprint. This is a great opportunity for TIC partners, owner-users, investors, or developers. 90 Walkscore. Easy access to public transportation, 101, and 280.
